synthesizedFacts.fact: Eczema coxsackium is an enteroviral infection affecting children with atopic dermatitis, characterized by vesicles, bullae, and erosions.
Coxsackievirus A6 and A16 are the most common causes of eczema coxsackium.
Eczema coxsackium can present with symptoms similar to hand, foot, and mouth disease but is more widespread and severe in individuals with eczema.
The condition is not life-threatening and usually resolves with supportive care, but monitoring for complications is important.
Eczema coxsackium can affect non-eczematous conditions with epidermal barrier breakdown.
